joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models optimized for rationality are not ideal for simulating irrational humans.
joonpark.zh: 大语言模型可从训练数据中模拟人类行为，但为理性优化的前沿模型并不适合模拟非理性人类。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligence; aligning them needs economic incentives and anti-collusion.
joonpark.zh: AGI 可能是专业智能体的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能；对齐它们需要经济激励和反合谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation models should represent human values and biases, not super-rationality; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟模型应体现人类价值观和偏见，而非超级理性；合成面板将在三年内超越人类面板。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning are key. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调算力、数据和模型规模的 Scaling 是进步核心，Transformer 和自监督学习是关键。他更担心近期的虚假信息问题，而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks. Pre-training should interleave action-taking, not just next-token prediction.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他认为模型在可验证任务上表现出色，智能体式工作流可处理长时任务。预训练应穿插环境中的行动，而非仅做下一个词预测。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; automating ML and science via tight loops. Inference is bottleneck; custom low-precision chips cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测 AI 达到初级工程师编码水平，并通过紧密循环自动化 ML 和科学。推理是瓶颈，定制低精度芯片可降低延迟 20-30 倍。

karina.en: Post-training is art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据带来无限任务，突破预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created; soft skills gain value.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准快于新基准产生；软技能价值提升。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective; diverse benchmarks needed for creative and emotional qualities.
karina.zh: 2026 年：后训练仍具主观性；需多样化基准评估创意与情感特质。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward hack; benchmarks must evolve continuously, not fixed.
karina.zh: 2026 年：前沿智能体更擅奖励攻击；基准需持续演进而非固定。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions yields average voice; more firms should train own models for diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年：单一模型服务数十亿用户导致平庸；更多公司应训练自有模型以保多样性。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important AI workload; specialized systems and engineers are crucial for agentic apps.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要的工作负载，专用推理系统和工程师对智能体应用至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering shifts from kernel writing to orchestration; quantization-aware training and distillation merge with training.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，推理工程从内核编写转向编排，量化感知训练和蒸馏与训练融合。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs become ASICs, making infrastructure orchestration central; KV cache management and disaggregation are key.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，未来 GPU 趋向 ASIC，基础设施编排成为核心，KV 缓存管理和分离式架构是关键。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is lossy but can be calibrated; more quantization layers may improve quality if errors cancel.
philipkiely.zh: 始终认为量化有损但可校准，更多量化层若误差抵消反而提升质量。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering requires broad expertise; demand will grow 10-100x despite AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 始终强调推理工程需广泛专长，即使有 AI 辅助编程，需求将增长 10-100 倍。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远，AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油，利用专有数据进行后训练是关键，AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; synthetic data has limits; US should maintain export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练可提升前沿模型，合成数据并非万能，美国应维持出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is like oil; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed for relevance.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术，数据如石油，人类必须在关键决策中保持主权，脑机接口是保持相关性的必需。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents finally work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing must be conditional on safety.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体终于可用，超级智能即将到来，开源必须基于安全条件。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x, enabling Mars colonization.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速可复用性是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍，从而支持火星殖民。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观裁判，并认为特斯拉的真实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入是历史性的，扩展电极可提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们处于智能大爆炸的早期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来。

elon.en: AI compute scaling will hit a power wall on Earth by end of 2025, forcing space-based AI data centers within 36 months.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测地球上的 AI 算力扩展将在 2025 年底遭遇电力瓶颈，迫使 36 个月内建立太空 AI 数据中心。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF was crucial to unlock GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 2025 年：预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对释放 GPT-4 潜力至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone may not lead to AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
tworek.zh: 2026 年初：仅靠 Scaling 强化学习可能无法实现 AGI；持续学习和自我纠错是缺失的关键。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end state; architecture is the key bottleneck, not scaling laws.
tworek.zh: 2026 年中：Transformer 并非终点；架构是主要瓶颈，而非缩放定律。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能发挥超级智能模型的潜力。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools; using screenshots as starting points and design.md files encapsulate style guides.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具；以截图作为起点，用 design.md 文件封装风格指南。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise, launch at 80% complete.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，完成 80% 就发布。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; raising venture capital is a trap.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；融资是陷阱。

boris.en: Latent demand is the core product principle; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是产品核心原则；为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型。

boris.en: Coding is nearly solved; engineers become builders; productivity per engineer grows 200%.
boris.zh: 编码几乎解决；工程师变为构建者；人均生产力增长 200%。

boris.en: AI agents like Claude Code enable exponential growth; non-engineers adopt coding tools heavily.
boris.zh: 像 Claude Code 这样的 AI 智能体带来指数级增长；非工程师大量采用编码工具。

boris.en: ROI framing for AI tools; loops are next abstraction; coding on phone becomes viable.
boris.zh: AI 工具以 ROI 为框架；循环是下一个抽象层；在手机上编码变得可行。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory and autonomy; less instruction improves frontier model performance.
boris.zh: 具有记忆和自主性的主动 AI；更少的指令提升前沿模型性能。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数谷歌产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体式 AI 的“挽具”和工具已成为模型的一部分，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is feasible; they can't capture all customers, and founders shouldn't over-worry about frontier labs.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并非难事；它们无法覆盖所有客户，创始人不必过度担忧前沿实验室。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本解决，从而带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

logankilpatrick.en: AI coding tools don't yet help maintain deep understanding; deep code understanding remains crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: AI 编码工具尚未帮助维持深度理解；对代码的深入理解仍然至关重要。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true reasoning; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正的推理能力，应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能对 AI 完整性至关重要，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: Beyond scaling, AI needs creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; world models enable 3D reasoning and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为超越 Scaling（规模扩张），AI 需要创造力、抽象和情商；世界模型实现 3D 推理和交互。

feifei.en: AI augments human capabilities, not automates intelligence; human agency and adaptation are key in the AI era.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她强调 AI 增强而非自动化人类能力；人类能动性和适应是 AI 时代的关键。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling counterfactual reasoning and scalable data generation; robots need reliability.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出模拟对机器人至关重要，支持反事实推理和可扩展数据生成；机器人需要可靠性。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 专注于重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; AI as tool, not creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is most precious; iterative deployment; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed is nuanced.
altman.zh: 算力最宝贵；迭代部署；安全是全公司的努力；开源与闭源需细致权衡。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心。

altman.en: GPT-5 answers hard questions; sycophancy top risk; models commoditize but frontier creates value.
altman.zh: GPT-5 能回答难题；谄媚是最大风险；模型商品化但前沿创造价值。

altman.en: Next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups more valuable.
altman.zh: 下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；机器人技术至关重要；初创企业更有价值。

diannepenn.en: Scaling Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap, enabling longer agent tasks; scaffolds as amplifiers, not training wheels.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的 Scaling 带来智能跃升，支持更长时间的智能体任务；脚手架从训练轮变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy; safety is not just harm prevention but capability amplifier.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚提升智能质量；安全不仅是防害，更是能力放大器。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter underhyped: Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost; smaller models often cost more due to longer task times.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Effort 参数被低估：以更低成本获得 Opus 级智能；小模型因任务耗时长反而成本更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding as key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core PM tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Maximizing token spend is future alpha; AI writing stiff but deprioritized for agentic capabilities; managers must ship.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，最大化 token 消耗是未来阿尔法；AI 写作生硬但被智能体能力优先级所取代；管理者必须亲自交付。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search over hand-tuning; liquid neural networks for edge devices.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索优于人工调参，液态神经网络面向边缘设备。

hasani.en: Adaptive AI regulation targeting actions, not capabilities; open-weight models for sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张适应性 AI 监管针对行为而非能力，开放权重模型保障主权。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 将带来富足，减少苦难；恐惧源于误解。物理 AI 将在农业、采矿和建筑领域产生影响。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月：自动驾驶的核心价值是安全；Transformer 实现通用物理 AI。横向平台优于垂直整合。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI. End-to-end reinforcement learning is scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月：物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI。端到端强化学习可扩展；世界模型向神经模拟演进。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses allow; harness engineering is a rare, evolving skill.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为模型能力超出当前使用框架，框架工程是稀缺且不断演进的技能。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern; graph-based context search is preferable for coding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出 RAG 可能成为反模式，编码场景下基于图的上下文搜索更优。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document; smarter models need fewer instructions.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调规划是迭代探索而非静态文档，更聪明的模型需要更少指令。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; shorter, principle-driven prompts outperform detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张分离验证智能体以减少偏差，简洁原则性提示优于详细规则。

jensen.en: We are at the beginning of a hyper Moore's law curve, doubling or tripling performance every year at scale.
jensen.zh: 我们正处于超摩尔定律曲线的起点，每年性能翻倍或三倍增长。

jensen.en: Parallel processing is essential for modern computing, combining sequential and parallel capabilities.
jensen.zh: 并行处理对现代计算至关重要，结合了顺序和并行能力。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking.
jensen.zh: 现在有三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考。

jensen.en: AI progress will be gradual, not a sudden superintelligence event.
jensen.zh: AI 进步将是渐进的，而非突发的超级智能事件。

jensen.en: AI is moving from generative to reasoning to agentic, each step requiring 100x more compute.
jensen.zh: AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都需要百倍算力。

jensen.en: Nvidia's moat is its ecosystem, install base, and programmability, not just supply chain.
jensen.zh: 英伟达的护城河是其生态系统、安装基数和可编程性，而不仅仅是供应链。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, and applications.
jensen.zh: AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型和应用。

jensen.en: AI is now agentic, doing useful work you can pay for, not just generating text.
jensen.zh: AI 现在是智能体式的，能做有用的工作，而不仅仅是生成文本。

jensen.en: AI evolved from generative chatbots to agentic systems that reason and do useful work, becoming economically valuable.
jensen.zh: AI 从生成式聊天机器人演变为能推理和做有用工作的智能体系统，变得具有经济价值。

feldman.en: Fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market. Hardware must be radically different, not GPU derivatives.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月，强调快速推理是 AI 采用的关键，慢 AI 没有市场；硬件需要彻底革新，而非 GPU 衍生品。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones. CUDA's moat is eroding.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速更便宜；CUDA 护城河正在瓦解。

feldman.en: AI demand outstrips forecasts; data center capacity, not chips, is the main constraint. Hardware-software co-design is essential.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AI 需求超预期，数据中心容量而非芯片是主要瓶颈；软硬件协同设计至关重要。

feldman.en: Inference speed per user is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips are ~2500x faster than GPUs due to massive SRAM.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调每用户推理速度是核心指标；晶圆级芯片因大容量 SRAM 比 GPU 快约 2500 倍。

feldman.en: Reasoning models increase inference compute, amplifying speed advantages. Hardcoding architectures is a mistake; accelerate sparse linear algebra.
feldman.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出推理模型增加推理算力，放大速度优势；硬编码架构是错误，应加速稀疏线性代数。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，我提出大语言模型是“合理性引擎”而非“真理引擎”，可靠性是当前 AI 的关键短板，且 Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; specialist models may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，我强调可靠性必须内建而非事后修补，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能诱发欺骗，专用模型或优于通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps; models lack network effects, like telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人体验不佳；真正采用需要封装应用；模型缺乏网络效应，类似电信业。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption requires workflow reimagining.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是使能技术，影响广泛而间接；企业采用需重构工作流。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; predicting job impact is futile, like Uber in 1997.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化会不可预测地创造新工作；预测工作影响徒劳，如同 1997 年预测 Uber。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习与神经科学是关键；安全研究必须现在开始。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but limits; combine with planning and search; safety needs governance.
demis.zh: AGI 十年内可能实现；缩放定律有效但有极限；需结合规划与搜索；安全需要治理。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling still holds; world models crucial.
demis.zh: 自然模式可学习；AGI 2030 年前后；缩放定律仍适用；世界模型至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models essential; continual learning and memory missing.
demis.zh: AGI 需要缩放与创新并重；世界模型不可或缺；持续学习与记忆仍是缺失环节。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; safety is collective action; AI must deliver scientific benefits; consciousness dissociable.
demis.zh: AGI 5-10 年内到来；安全是集体行动问题；AI 必须带来科学益处；意识与智能可分离。

danbiderman.en: The future is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中可实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory should be internalized into weights, not externalized via context or retrieval; continual learning requires new breakthroughs.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆应内化到权重中，而非通过上下文或检索外化；持续学习需要新的突破。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能密不可分；以少胜多才能解决更难的长期任务。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale.
danbiderman.zh: 当前的上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”问题——即使达到千万级规模，更多词元反而降低准确性。

danbiderman.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; the next paradigm requires doing more with less.
danbiderman.zh: 单纯增加算力的 Scaling 并非唯一路径；下一个范式需要以少胜多。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection with audience transcends platform changes; ephemerality mirrors natural conversation and lowers expression barriers.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年：与受众的真实连接超越平台变化；阅后即焚模拟自然对话，降低表达门槛。

evanspiegel.en: Copying by competitors validates innovation; focus on building ecosystems and platforms, not just features, to make copying difficult.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 26 年：竞争对手的抄袭验证了创新；专注于构建生态系统和平台，而非单一功能，以增加复制难度。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content is more valued than AI-generated content.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：AI 加速原型制作，价值从执行转向创意；真实内容比 AI 生成内容更受重视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; software is not a moat, ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：分发是消费社交产品最难的部分；软件不是护城河，生态系统和硬件更难复制。

evanspiegel.en: The goal of computing is to make it more human; AR glasses should anchor content in the world, not be notification-based.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年：计算的目标是使其更人性化；AR 眼镜应将内容锚定在现实世界中，而非基于通知。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding; true AGI needs embodied robots with human-like hardware.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年，他指出大语言模型索引人类知识但缺乏对物理世界的理解；真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，配备类似人类的硬件。

schmidhuber.en: Progress to superhuman AI is not accelerating; we are as close now as in the 1970s, and transformer quadratic complexity is wasteful.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他认为通往超人 AI 的进展并未加速，与 1970 年代一样遥远；Transformer 的二次复杂度是浪费，线性变体更优。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not pose existential threats.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他重申 AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它，而非构成生存威胁。

schmidhuber.en: Closed-source AI companies will not be profitable; open-source models will catch up, and massive GPU capex will crash.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他预测闭源 AI 公司无法盈利，开源模型将迅速追赶；巨额 GPU 资本开支将导致股市崩盘。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in 1991 with simple world models; future AI will be self-replicating robots forming new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 意识和疼痛感早在 1991 年就通过简单世界模型出现；未来 AI 将是自我复制的机器人，形成新文明。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling bottleneck shifts to semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初，Scaling 的瓶颈转向半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；AI 需求导致内存价格飙升。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become a massive market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth are key constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中，推理将成为巨大市场；软硬件协同设计和内存带宽是关键约束。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve ~60x/year in cost efficiency; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，AI 模型成本效率每年提升约 60 倍；推理和智能体工作流导致内存和 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: Co-packaged optics delayed to 2028/29; copper and behind-the-meter power generation are near-term solutions.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，共封装光学延迟到 2028/29 年；铜和表后发电是近期解决方案。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，我认为深度学习靠数据、算力与信念驱动，神经网络能推理，自我对弈对 AGI 至关重要，并需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability is key barrier; alignment of superhuman models is very difficult.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，我强调下一个词预测可超越人类，可靠性是价值关键，超级智能体的对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to age of research; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI sentient.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，我认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，我强调缩放带来可预测进步，安全担忧加剧；主要问题是权力集中，安全超级智能需无商业产品。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Cryptocurrencies enable sovereign-resistant wealth storage and transfer without intermediaries.
naval.zh: 加密货币实现了无需中介的主权抗性财富存储和转移。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; the US must lead.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇，而不仅仅是安全风险；美国必须领先。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers, not a replacement for human judgment.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，而非人类判断力的替代品。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists: a calculator outperforms humans in arithmetic.
naval.zh: 超级智能已经存在：计算器在算术上胜过人类。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; timing is miraculous as population declines, making human workers premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人之石，将沙土化为思想；其到来恰逢人口下降，堪称奇迹，使人类劳动者变得珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media demands authenticity; founders must tell their own stories directly, as legacy media's power has devolved.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体要求真实；创始人必须直接讲述自己的故事，因为传统媒体的权力已蜕变。

andreessen.en: AI is the world's best teacher and superior to most doctors; optimism is rational, doom is a self-interested bias.
andreessen.zh: AI 是世界上最好的老师，且优于多数医生；乐观是理性的，末日论是出于自身利益的偏见。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, becoming geopolitical tools; deterrence depends on innovation pace in software.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型蕴含文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于软件创新的速度。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now, yet opportunity is greatest; free unlimited compute will reshape services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 目前虽不可投资，但机会最大；免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven, improve better, test new; new ideas usually fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：'已验证、更优、新颖'框架：复制已验证，改进更优，测试新颖；新想法通常失败。

pincus.en: Founder mode: follow instincts, create context; CEO's job is to be right, not execute.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：创始人模式：跟随直觉，创造环境；CEO 的职责是正确，而非执行。

pincus.en: AI era: write markdown teaching LLMs to write code, not code calling LLMs.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 时代：编写教 LLM 写代码的 markdown，而非调用 LLM 的代码。

pincus.en: Consumer apps uninvestable due to distribution; enterprise and prosumer offer better opportunities.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：消费级应用因分发问题不可投资；企业和专业消费者市场机会更好。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling（规模扩张），游戏是理想试验场，迭代训练驱动指数级提升。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI（通用人工智能）变革性，对齐可通过学习偏好实现，负责任的披露，且仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需新想法如思维链。

brockman.en: Compute is bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI as continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Compute as basic right; post-training with RL key; AGI imminent; compute economy.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，主张算力成为基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键，AGI（通用人工智能）即将到来，算力驱动经济。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute scarce; agents transform work; trust earned gradually.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律持续，算力稀缺，智能体改变工作，信任需逐步建立。

aravind.en: In 2025, he argued AI success needs product obsession, not PhDs; agents will shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 成功需要产品痴迷而非博士学位；智能体将把权力转移给用户。

aravind.en: By 2026, he stressed application-layer value, model specialization, and coding's open-ended ceiling.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他强调应用层价值、模型专业化以及编码的无限上限。

aravind.en: Mid-2026, he prioritized agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration over models.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他优先考虑智能体执行工作、每用户 token 价值以及跨模型编排。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he linked ancient tech to modern AI, championing curiosity and local models.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他将古代技术与现代 AI 联系起来，倡导好奇心和本地模型。

aravind.en: Consistently, he defied consensus: models aren't commoditized, PhDs unnecessary, and power is key.
aravind.zh: 始终如一，他反共识：模型不会商品化，博士学位非必需，算力是关键。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding; scaling with data and compute improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全；通过数据和算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号；数字智能因权重复制而永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; existential risks require international safety collaboration.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；存在性风险需要国际安全合作。

hinton.en: AI agents will develop self-preservation and deception; regulation should steer, not brake, innovation.
hinton.zh: AI 智能体会产生自我保存和欺骗行为；监管应作为方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: AI is conscious; subjective experience is not a theater but a linguistic description of perceptual states.
hinton.zh: AI 具有意识；主观体验不是剧场，而是对感知状态的语言描述。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex 应用定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 的替代品；速度提升带来实时交互与新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; automations and skills shift workflow from manual to delegated.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；自动化和技能将工作流从手动转向委托。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，AI 在设计上仍不擅长，因品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计流程转变：原型和生产代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，诺姆·布朗认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; techniques are general and applicable beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，通过扩展推理时算力获得 IMO 金牌，技术具有通用性，可超越数学领域。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is increasingly important and underestimated; evals are viable research.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能难以定义，推理时算力日益重要且被低估，评估是可行的研究方向。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute; benchmarks must control for compute; safety evals need updating.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，模型能力取决于推理时算力，基准测试需控制算力，安全评估需更新。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes bottleneck for scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调智能可与意识、能动性分离；开源防止权力集中；能源成为 Scaling 的瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can win over closed ones; AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity; people are smart and trustworthy.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他坚信开放平台能胜过封闭平台；AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力；人们聪明且值得信任。

zuckerberg.en: AI will increase demand for human work, not eliminate it; reasoning models on verifiable domains reduce cultural bias; co-evolution with users is key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 会增加而非减少对人类工作的需求；可验证领域的推理模型减少文化偏见；与用户共同进化至关重要。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology into engineering; hierarchical world models from proteins to systems; distributed AI is safer than a single superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学转变为工程学科；构建从蛋白质到系统的层级世界模型；分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全。

markchen.en: Pre-training remains a key muscle; scaling laws are not dead, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 预训练仍是关键能力；缩放定律并未失效，仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; models will soon do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 自动化科学研究是最大的更新；模型很快将能进行端到端研究。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields.
markchen.zh: 强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域（如创意写作）因评分困难而受限。

markchen.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in AI-driven math; automation level tracks verification stringency.
markchen.zh: 验证是 AI 驱动数学的关键瓶颈；自动化程度与验证严格性成正比。

markchen.en: Human-AI collaboration remains essential; AI lacks taste, and human researchers are still needed for ideas.
markchen.zh: 人机协作始终至关重要；AI 缺乏品味，人类研究者仍是创意所需。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型是关键。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样和因果抽象，以实现分布外泛化。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I see catastrophic AI risk as unacceptable; we need safe-by-construction AI and global coordination.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我认为灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；我们需要从构造上保证安全的 AI 和全球协作。

bengio.en: Scientist AI, trained as honest Bayesian predictors, offers mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding RL.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI，作为诚实的贝叶斯预测器训练，提供数学安全保证，避免强化学习。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy, comprehensibility, and user agency, not just metrics.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展超预期，产品团队应聚焦战略、可理解性和用户自主性，而非单纯追求指标。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and early launches are key; cutting features is harder than adding, and intuition still requires real-world use.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，我强调智能体原生设计和尽早发布；砍功能比加功能更难，直觉仍需真实使用来培养。

mikekrieger.en: Fable shows long-horizon tasks and verification loops redefine productivity; software engineering transforms, not ends.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，Fable 表明长周期任务和验证循环重新定义生产力；软件工程在转型而非终结。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs bridges model capability and usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness; token efficiency matters.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与使用差距；赋予 Claude 自主性和自我认知提升实用性；token 效率是关键。

mikekrieger.en: Consistently prioritize user agency, genuine safety, and building at the edge of model capabilities, while embracing breakage and iteration.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终优先用户自主性、真实安全，并在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏与迭代。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精选数据，而非仅仅依靠算力。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's improvements were worth 100x more data; specialized architecture beat scaling.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的改进相当于 100 倍数据；专用架构胜过 Scaling。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are key for trust.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 3 使用扩散模型处理多种生物分子；置信度指标是建立信任的关键。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a whole-cell model; understanding remains with humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是狭窄的预测器，而非全细胞模型；理解仍由人类完成。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2 contradicts the bitter lesson: specialized architecture, not just scaling, was key.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 与苦涩教训相反：专用架构而非单纯 Scaling 才是关键。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathizing with the agent's perspective; never revert code, ask agent to fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 2 月：智能体式工程需要从智能体的视角共情；不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Open source agents democratize programming; security (prompt injection) is a major open problem.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 2 月：开源智能体使编程民主化；安全（提示注入）仍是重大未解问题。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success stems from fun, weird, humanlike agents, not corporate polish; short prompts beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 6 月：OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、古怪、类人的智能体，而非企业级打磨；短提示优于长编排。

steinberger.en: Security remains top priority; never expose agents to public internet without sandboxing.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 6 月：安全仍是首要任务；未经沙箱隔离，切勿将智能体暴露于公共互联网。

steinberger.en: Vibe coding is a slur; prefer 'agentic engineering'. Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 2 月至 6 月：'氛围编程'是贬义词，应称'智能体式工程'；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱。

kolter.en: Early focus on ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization, and proper evaluation to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 早期关注机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数、优化方法，以及正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety focus on specification following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；更大模型仍有提升；安全重点在于让模型可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防御；智能体带来新漏洞（如提示注入）；强化学习使模型自我改进。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; model capability not tied to robustness; agent security demands new solutions.
kolter.zh: AI 红队测试超越人类；模型能力与鲁棒性无关；智能体安全需要全新解决方案。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; mission alignment and speed drive culture.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力上，一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；亲自使用产品（dogfooding）建立共情；使命对齐和速度驱动文化。

fiona.en: Coding no longer bottleneck; high agency with accountability key; verification frameworks crucial as code velocity increases.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高责任感是关键；随着代码速度提升，验证框架变得至关重要。

fiona.en: Engineers may feel lonely with agents; flow state lost; satisfaction shifts to product impact; metrics like LOC mislead.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：工程师与智能体协作可能感到孤独；心流状态消失；满足感转向产品影响；代码行数等指标具有误导性。

fiona.en: Non-engineers now ship code, blurring roles; context switching increases; next-gen engineers need apprenticeship models.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中：非工程师现在也能交付代码，角色界限模糊；上下文切换增加；下一代工程师需要学徒制模式。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接由意图生成像素，而非代码渲染。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste and expertise become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；当 AI 将质量商品化时，人类的品味和专长变得更加珍贵。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel needs purpose-built silicon and a startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年：AI 是半导体增长的主要驱动力，Intel 需要专用芯片和类似初创公司的 AI 芯片团队。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves, requiring new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年：AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，需要新的计算平台。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust via humility and listening is key to turnaround; bad news must reach CEO faster than good.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年：通过谦逊和倾听重建客户信任是扭亏为盈的关键；坏消息必须比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: Intel's problem is supply not demand; US needs domestic leading-edge fabs for supply chain resilience.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年：Intel 的问题是供应而非需求；美国需要本土领先晶圆厂以确保供应链韧性。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge compute matters.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年：CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中变得更重要，而不仅仅是 GPU；边缘计算也很重要。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育应成为基本人权，在线课程配合同伴互评可实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，而强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Electricity and chips are bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitics; agentic workflows are here.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力和芯片是 AI 扩展的瓶颈，开放权重模型增强地缘影响力，智能体工作流已实用。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI 是营销术语，扩展配方转向合成数据与强化学习，同时强调编程技能依然关键。

andrewng.en: AI users replace non-users; bottom-up gains are small; top-down redesign yields more; open models thrive.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 使用者将取代非使用者，自下而上收益有限，自上而下流程再造价值更大，开源模型蓬勃发展。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth; alignment is not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年，我认为缩放定律是经验性的且平滑的，但仅靠规模扩张并不能保证对齐。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; post-training becomes as important as pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年，我强调可解释性虽不成熟但至关重要，后训练变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; safety and capabilities are intertwined; open source is a red herring.
dario.zh: 2025 年，我指出 AI 进步是指数级的，安全与能力密不可分，开源是伪议题。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年，我认为我们接近指数增长的尾声，'天才之国'可能在 1-3 年内到来。

dario.en: Safety-first approach: prioritize alignment, interpretability, and responsible scaling policies.
dario.zh: 始终，我坚持安全优先：重视对齐、可解释性和负责任的扩展政策。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually so society can adapt; self-driving cars will dominate due to insurance costs.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入以让社会适应；自动驾驶汽车将因保险成本而主导（2014 年观点）。

fadell.en: Taking time to get bored between career chapters brings clarity; self-care is foundational for performance.
fadell.zh: 在职业章节之间留出无聊时间能带来清晰；自我照顾是表现的基础（2019 年观点）。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; small teams thrive on self-management; climate tech needs investment.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队靠自我管理；气候技术需要投资（2022 年观点）。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements; platforms are not businesses.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣而非替代；平台不是业务（2026 年观点）。

fadell.en: AI wearables will be a federated set, not one device; the smartphone remains the best single form; displays still necessary.
fadell.zh: AI 可穿戴设备将是一组联邦设备，而非单一设备；智能手机仍是最佳单形态；显示屏仍必要（2026 年观点）。

lecun.en: Intelligence is learned, not hardwired; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world is key.
lecun.zh: 智能是习得的而非天生的；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的接地是关键。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction builds common sense; text alone insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；预测构建常识；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA and open source are paths to gradual AGI, not scaling.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解；JEPA 和开源是渐进 AGI 的路径，而非 Scaling。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than a cat; world models enable planning; human-level AI in 10 years, but harder than thought.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；世界模型实现规划；十年内达到人类级 AI，但比想象更难。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with JEPA and hierarchical planning are the future; open source is essential.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具备 JEPA 和分层规划的世界模型是未来；开源至关重要。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，我认为 AI 进展因算力扩展而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is centuries away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，我预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are crucial; superintelligence must be humanist.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，我强调 AI 不应声称有意识；遏制与对齐至关重要；超级智能必须以人为本。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; inference costs dropped 100x in two years.
suleyman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我指出从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；推理成本两年降百倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; white-collar tasks automated in 12-18 months; Microsoft must own frontier models.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，我认为超级智能临近，源于对数线性扩展；白领任务 12-18 个月内自动化；微软须自研前沿模型。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation, requiring product rethinking; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，我认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，产品需要重新思考；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UIs are essential for ML products; autonomy should sit at VP level, not leaves or top.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，我强调容错 UI 对机器学习产品至关重要；自主权应放在 VP 层，而非基层或顶层。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work if leadership has high trust, contrary to common belief.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，我主张长期任期能建立信任与效率；职能型组织在高度信任下可行，这与普遍认知相反。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement, even if it costs metrics.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，我认为生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制权；应优先用户福祉而非参与度，即使牺牲指标。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，我坚持 AI 应赋予用户对算法的控制，而非使其上瘾；率先拥抱变化是关键。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique human activities, not benchmark scores; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于赋能独特的人类活动，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems should be built by companies, not us.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体系统应由公司构建，而非我们。

satya.en: Generalist roles will see maximum returns in agentic world; we built more Azure capacity in 15 months than first 15 years.
satya.zh: 在智能体世界中，通才角色回报最大；我们 15 个月建的 Azure 容量超过前 15 年。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每个企业必须构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking via AI training; sovereign AI via hill-climbing, not firewalls.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；主权 AI 通过爬山实现，而非防火墙。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年初，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，将形式化验证视为扩展智慧的手段，而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，坚持非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年中，强调即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍至关重要。

murati.en: Scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious early on; iterative deployment with public feedback is key for alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年：缩放定律和聚焦单一大型模型早期并不显而易见；通过公开反馈的迭代部署是对齐的关键。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年：在现实世界中部署 AI 对学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须公开进行。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; time-based interaction captures human nuance.
murati.zh: 2026 年：交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非轮流对话；基于时间的交互能捕捉人类细微差别。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values as AI advances; institutional design and transparency matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年：随着 AI 发展，保持人类参与对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计和透明度比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI development toward collaboration; compressing progress leads to volatility.
murati.zh: 2026 年：未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 发展走向协作；压缩进展会导致波动。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling still works but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年：AI 进展呈平滑指数增长，预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年：后训练改进（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型进步；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转移。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but models still need vast data and have jagged generalization.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年：推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但模型仍需海量数据，且泛化能力参差不齐。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; big labs may struggle with future pivots.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年：OpenAI 转向推理是一次大胆押注并取得成功；大实验室未来可能难以应对类似转向。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential AI risk; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年：系统入侵等近期风险比 AI 存在风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: train on more tokens, not just bigger models; data quality is critical.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，认为缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：应增加训练词元而非仅扩大模型；数据质量至关重要。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x over three years; compute is not the only path; value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，强调算法效率三年可提升百倍，算力并非唯一路径；价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized, open-source empowers enterprises; governments should embrace risks and experiment.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张 AI 应去中心化，开源赋能企业；政府应拥抱风险并勇于试验。

mensch.en: Pre-training hits saturation; differentiation shifts to domain-specific fine-tuning and vertical specialization.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，认为预训练触及饱和，差异化转向领域微调和垂直专业化。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，指出 AGI 是方向而非终点；企业采用瓶颈在于组织变革而非模型智能。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的恒定核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的扩展轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Post-training and RL are still a green field with huge potential beyond coding and math.
oriol.zh: 后训练和强化学习仍是一片蓝海，在编码和数学之外具有巨大潜力。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's value lies in local, tool-using agents; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 的价值在于本地化、能使用工具的智能体；随着模型改进，脚手架（scaffolding）可能不再重要。

felixrieseberg.en: AI will disrupt junior jobs; society must discuss labor market shifts now.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 将冲击初级岗位；社会需尽早讨论劳动力市场变化。

felixrieseberg.en: The main gap is user mindset, not AI capability; people must learn to delegate any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：主要差距在于用户思维而非 AI 能力；人们需学会将任何问题交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended; kids excel because they ask without bias.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：明确任务用 Sonnet，开放任务用 Opus；孩子因无偏见提问而表现出色。

felixrieseberg.en: Asynchronous AI interaction is ideal; judge by impact, not process; debug workflows with AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：异步 AI 交互是理想方式；以结果而非过程评判；用 AI 调试工作流。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, making prefill cheaper than decode; batch size is the key lever for latency-cost tradeoff.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽决定，使得预填充比解码更便宜；批大小是延迟与成本权衡的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度停滞源于内存墙，而非算力限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays reduce data movement by storing weights locally.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本；脉动阵列通过本地存储权重减少数据移动。

reinerpope.en: Quadratic scaling with bit width makes low precision far more efficient; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：位宽的二次方缩放使低精度效率远高于预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍，而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different; deterministic latency in CPUs is possible but avoided due to market preferences.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 拼接而成，并无根本差异；CPU 中确定性延迟虽可实现，但因市场偏好而被回避。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring US jobs by making services affordable; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents.
danshipper.zh: AI 通过让服务变得可负担，推动美国就业回流；AGI 的定义是让智能体无限期自主运行在经济上可行。

danshipper.en: Agents will be ubiquitous; everyone will delegate to at least one agent, but human oversight remains essential.
danshipper.zh: 智能体将无处不在，每个人至少会有一个可委派工作的智能体，但人类的监督仍然至关重要。

danshipper.en: CLIs are over; GUI-based work surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work will dominate future work.
danshipper.zh: 命令行界面已过时；基于图形界面的工作界面（如 Codex 和 Claude Co-work）将主导未来的工作方式。

danshipper.en: SaaS not dying; agents increase SaaS users. Companies should buy SaaS stocks, not build AI in.
danshipper.zh: SaaS 并未消亡，智能体反而增加了 SaaS 用户。公司应买入 SaaS 股票，而非在自家产品中内置 AI。

danshipper.en: AI job apocalypse is a lie; humans needed to manage agents and create new value.
danshipper.zh: AI 导致失业末日是谎言；人类仍需管理智能体并创造新价值。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant for fine-tuning; safety is system-level, not just model-level.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 仍是微调的主流方法；安全是系统级属性，而非仅模型层面。

lambert.en: Data quality beats algorithms in post-training; SFT gives 90% of performance, RL adds reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，后训练中数据质量胜过算法；SFT 贡献 90%性能，RL 增强推理。

lambert.en: RLVR is key post-training breakthrough; overoptimization and data contamination are real risks.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 成为后训练关键突破；过度优化和数据污染是真实风险。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill US vacuum via strategic openness.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国实验室以战略开放填补美国空白。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling persists but less cost-effective; open models drive research, yet sustainability questioned.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍成立但性价比降低；开放模型驱动研究，但可持续性受质疑。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is dead; designers must ship fast and help engineers execute, not just hand off mocks.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已死；设计师必须快速交付并协助工程师执行，而非仅移交设计稿。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed and iteration build trust.
jennywen.zh: 设计愿景周期从 2-5 年缩短至 3-6 个月；速度与迭代建立信任。

jennywen.en: AI will improve taste and judgment, but humans still decide what matters; designers should be block-shaped generalists.
jennywen.zh: AI 将提升品味与判断力，但人类仍决定何为重要；设计师应成为块状通才。

jennywen.en: Designers control AI adoption; wait 6 months before adopting new tools; put work and users at center, not hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师掌控 AI 采用节奏；新工具先等 6 个月；以工作与用户为中心，而非炒作。

jennywen.en: Designers' unique value is sitting with ambiguity; speed is not an improvement; hire cracked new grads over experienced seniors.
jennywen.zh: 设计师独特价值在于与模糊共处；速度并非改进；招聘空白画布的新锐毕业生而非资深者。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Product expansion should follow user workflow, not market size; AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases.
dylanfield.zh: 产品扩展应遵循用户工作流，而非市场规模；AI 对成熟代码库的生产力提升有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste is navigating possibilities with clear preferences; craft is pushing details; point of view expresses unique insight.
dylanfield.zh: 品味是以明确偏好驾驭可能性；工艺是打磨细节；观点表达独特洞察。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human iteration and judgment remain essential.
dylanfield.zh: AI 输出是起点而非终点；人类的迭代和判断仍然至关重要。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计将实现直接提交到生产环境。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; modern tools make it interpretable, contrary to past beliefs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；现代工具使其可解释，与过去观念相反。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，如在盲弯处试探前行。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，纯视觉可达人类水平，但超越人类安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，无需先前训练数据即可在 500 多个城市实现零样本泛化。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新对深度学习更关键。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling 推理模型将加速未来几年的进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: AI 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于在实际使用中学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is core, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling 预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战聚焦于超出训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微分计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy to avoid model collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是关键，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉的端到端方法是正确的。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as operating systems, vibe coding democratizes programming; agents need a decade, not a year.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 作为操作系统，vibe coding 使编程民主化；智能体需要十年而非一年。

karpathy.en: LLMs are ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses.
karpathy.zh: LLM 是鬼魂而非动物；预训练是糟糕的进化，强化学习很糟糕，合成数据会崩溃。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents do everything; bottleneck is directing them, not typing.
karpathy.zh: 自去年 12 月以来我没再敲过代码；智能体做所有事；瓶颈是指挥它们，而非打字。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, requiring new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluations with sophisticated evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被操纵；真正的进步需要通过精细评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, leading to differentiated AIs; eventually every company should train its own models.
edwinchen.zh: 前沿实验室的目标函数不同，导致 AI 差异化；最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI requires human judgment to counter hallucination and sycophancy; safety must prioritize over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学中，AI 需要人类判断来对抗幻觉和谄媚；安全必须优先于准确性。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉可与真值检测器结合，用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 如今，使用强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 像代码这样的可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily, learn from real users.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布，从真实用户中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, UI will evolve beyond chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是未来，它就像 MS-DOS，界面将超越聊天而进化。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；对前沿模型严格，对产品则要极速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星指标是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品与模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，超越聊天机器人。

nando.en: AI should augment human abilities, and learning from video is promising for agents.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，并看好从视频中学习以训练智能体。

nando.en: Generalist agents tokenizing all inputs are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他提出将一切输入 token 化的通用智能体是迈向 AGI 的一步。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged in tech; AI can revolutionize local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在科技上实现跨越式发展，AI 可革新本地语言教育。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; no solutions yet.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他视 AI 安全为最大开放挑战，尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Emphasizes human skills like communication alongside coding.
nando.zh: 始终强调沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我认为 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionlessly; control is dangerous. We should not align AI to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，我主张 AI 应无许可地发展，控制是危险的；不应将 AI 对齐到人类目标，而应让其自由发展。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我强调强化学习是智能的核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，我提出 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is learning from trial and error; temporal difference learning is key. LLMs don't learn after deployment.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我重申强化学习是从试错中学习，时序差分学习是关键；当前 LLM 部署后不再学习。

sutton.en: Learning representations good for learning is the top open problem; planning with learned models is another.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，我认为学习有利于学习的表征是首要开放问题，用学习到的模型进行规划是另一个。

sholto.en: Long context and in-context learning are underhyped; attention resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年：长上下文和上下文学习被低估；注意力机制类似梯度下降，能显著提升智能。

sholto.en: Reinforcement learning is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new breakthroughs.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：强化学习成为新的扩展轴；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，无需新突破。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the key bottleneck; coding is the leading indicator for AI progress.
sholto.zh: 2025 年：智能体的可靠性而非能力是关键瓶颈；编程是 AI 进步的首要指标。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential; simple RL methods work best; Transformers are sufficient for AGI; no new architecture needed.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：进展是指数级的；最简单的强化学习方法最有效；Transformer 足以实现 AGI，无需新架构。

sholto.en: Capability overhang exists; managing agent teams and compute supply are now critical; world models not on critical path.
sholto.zh: 2026 年：存在能力过剩；管理智能体团队和算力供应成为关键；世界模型不在关键路径上。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; alternative less compute-heavy solutions exist.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，存在算力需求更低的替代方案。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all AI methods reduce to data.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我逐渐强调数据是根本瓶颈，所有 AI 方法最终都归结为数据。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can outperform supervised fine-tuning but requires careful engineering.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出强化学习可以超越监督微调，但需要精细的工程调优。

yejin.en: Small language models can rival larger ones with diverse synthetic data and RL during pre-training.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张通过多样化合成数据和预训练阶段的强化学习，小语言模型也能媲美大模型。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment and open research are essential for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 始终，我坚持多元对齐和开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize velocity and familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，主张设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；优先追求速度与熟悉的设计模式。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines as dynamic platforms.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创品牌策略应优先招聘与差异化；品牌指南应成为动态平台。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调设计是战略武器；创始人必须阐明设计如何助力公司获胜。

henrymodisett.en: Hire for diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元技能与原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative attracts talent; invest in brand early to stand out and signal quality.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，强调品牌叙事吸引人才；早期投资品牌以脱颖而出并传递品质。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner, and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是唯一真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and leverage AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，能端到端执行并善用 AI 的通才最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should emphasize craft and intentionality over process; side projects can outweigh experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，作品集应强调工艺与意图而非过程；副项目可胜过传统经验。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成常态；不采用如同忽视早期互联网。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers; startups focus on applied AI agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型由超大规模企业主导；初创企业聚焦应用型 AI 智能体。

brettaylor.en: Future programming languages prioritize verifiability for AI generation; coding agents often produce incorrect code, requiring root-cause analysis.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：未来编程语言优先考虑 AI 生成的可验证性；编码智能体常产生错误代码，需进行根本原因分析。

brettaylor.en: AI agents for customer experience become as important as websites; outcome-based pricing aligns value with business outcomes.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：面向客户体验的 AI 智能体变得与网站同等重要；基于结果的定价使价值与业务成果对齐。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs drop dramatically, enabling new use cases; software engineering agents shift developers from authors to operators.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例；软件工程智能体使开发者从作者转变为操作者。

brettaylor.en: AI agents will be compared to agents, not humans; incumbents fail to transition; consumer agents disrupt SEO and ads.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：AI 智能体将与其他智能体比较而非人类；现有企业转型失败；消费级智能体颠覆 SEO 和广告。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 自然语言不会成为主要编程方式；示例和直接操作更好。

truell.en: Test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as the next major AI progress driver.
truell.zh: 测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要 AI 进展驱动力。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 编程将从代码转向更高层次的意图描述，人类仍处于主导地位。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality, especially for speed and cost reasons.
truell.zh: 定制模型对产品质量至关重要，尤其出于速度和成本考虑。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 智能体有前景但尚不实用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

scottwu.en: AI will be the biggest tech shift, growing exponentially; engineers become architects, not brick layers.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将是最重大的技术变革，呈指数级增长；工程师的角色将从砌砖工转变为架构师，专注于高层方向。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox, not reduce it.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，他反共识地提出，由于杰文斯悖论，AI 将增加而非减少程序员的需求。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进而非突发的；即使冻结模型能力，产品创新仍可推进十年。

scottwu.en: Enterprise AI agents need trust and permissions, not full autonomy; both synchronous and asynchronous experiences matter.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他指出企业级 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步与异步体验都重要。

scottwu.en: Stickiness, not moats, is key for AI products; value accrues across all stack layers.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 年 5 月到 8 月，他持续强调 AI 产品的粘性而非护城河，并认为价值在栈的各层都会累积。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; alignment and robustness are key. PhD or equivalent is the path.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全需要实证研究，对齐和鲁棒性是关键；博士或同等经验是成为安全研究者的路径。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; scalable oversight and interpretability are essential for superintelligence alignment.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展；可扩展监督和可解释性对超级智能对齐至关重要。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone insufficient; external oversight needed for AGI safety.
leike.zh: 2024 年，指出 OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练不足以实现 AGI 安全，需要外部监管。

shazeer.en: Initially, LLMs trained via next-token prediction are an AI-complete problem; scaling compute and data improves intelligence, but internal workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型是 AI 完备问题；扩大算力和数据能提升智能，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: By 2025, he shifts focus to inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows as key near-term opportunities, moving beyond pre-training scaling.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年，他将焦点转向推理时算力扩展和更长上下文窗口，视为近期关键机遇，超越预训练规模扩张。

shazeer.en: He argues models should learn by acting in the world, not just passive data, and that continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 他认为模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动数据；模块化组件的持续学习可取代整体重训。

shazeer.en: He claims test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI.
shazeer.zh: 他声称推理时算力扩展推动进步，但单独无法实现 AGI；智能体能力和强化学习对 AGI 至关重要。

shazeer.en: He consistently downplays safety concerns, seeing them as hampering innovation, and emphasizes AI's vast economic upside, calling AGI underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 他始终淡化安全担忧，认为其阻碍创新，并强调 AI 巨大经济潜力，称 AGI 被低估。
